$description: cheap-mem viewer design tokens. Extracted from the inline <style> block of src/viewer.mjs, so every colour is a declared CSS custom property, not an inference. Mirrored byte-for-byte by lucky-mem/src/ansicht.mjs.

sunk.$description: recessed fill: chips, bar tracks, retired cards, row hover

faint.$description: tertiary text: timestamps, counts, file paths

accent.$description: state and type only: active lens, type chip, link kind, focus ring

warn-soft.$description: caution fill, also the search highlight

rule.$description: structural border; only ~1.4:1 on paper, see Open Questions

prose.$value: Charter, 'Bitstream Charter', 'Sitka Text', Cambria, Georgia, serif
prose.$description: anything a person or model SAID

code.$value: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

$value.fontFamily: Charter, 'Bitstream Charter', 'Sitka Text', Cambria, Georgia, serif
Charter, 'Bitstream Charter', 'Sitka Text', Cambria, Georgia, serif

prose.$description: remembered text, fact values, search field

$value.fontFamily: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace
ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

spine.$description: trail left rule, active tab underline, focus ring

anydesign.notes: There is no shadow token. Depth is surface tone plus a hairline, two tiers only.
There is no webfont and no pill radius, both deliberate. See docs/viewer-design.md.
Every pair in docs/viewer-design-a11y.md passes WCAG AA for normal text.
Four moving things, each answering a question: reading rail, gliding tab underline, card approach, lens fade. Nothing is infinite (WCAG 2.2.2) and nothing loads, so there are no loading states.
Every animation-timeline sits inside @supports — without it, a fill mode leaves the element permanently invisible where the feature is missing.

instant.$description: chip hover, disclosure arrow, summary colour

quick.$description: tab colour, row hover, lens fade-in

duration.$description: Named after the DISTANCE travelled, not by importance. All four become 0ms under prefers-reduced-motion, which is a token layer of its own rather than a patch.

crisp.$description: the tool-like snap; the tab underline

cubicBezier.$description: Split by DIRECTION — coming in and going out are not the same movement.

$workspace.$description: AS OF 2026-09-16: the workspace under / (src/astra.mjs) follows Lucky's study and deliberately departs from three rules in this file. That is a DECISION, not an oversight and not a silent rebuild — Lucky made it on that day, after the alternative ('close, but not the same') was explicitly on the table. A rule that quietly stops applying is worse than one that has visibly moved.
$workspace.does_not_apply_to: src/viewer.mjs and src/console.mjs. All rules below remain unchanged there.

deviations.price: The page is no longer entirely one file: on first load it fetches a stylesheet. Without a network it falls back to the system font — readable, but not the study. The DATA stays in the page; there is still no request that could fall back to invented sample data.
deviations.verified_by: test/dashboard.test.mjs — exactly ONE target outside the page is allowed, and it must be the font.

deviations.price: Whoever works in light mode gets no light counterpart. In exchange, the page carries its own background and a declared color-scheme, instead of borrowing the viewer's background — a half-built light theme would be worse than an honestly dark one.
deviations.verified_by: test/dashboard.test.mjs — color-scheme:dark and a background of its own on body are mandatory; a half-built light branch is caught.

unchanged: No shadow. Nobody touched that one, and a probe holds it in place.
No invented data and no fallback onto it.
Three states where there are three: not measured is never fine.
A caption never claims more than the image beneath it shows.

retracted.why: Measured on 2026-09-17 with the anydesign skill against the study's own stylesheet: it has NO pill radius at all. The radii run 2 to 13px, strictly growing from inside to outside, plus 50% for circles. The 999px stood in my replica out of habit, not in the original — so I had documented a deviation that never existed. Faithful to the original is, here, the same as rule-compliant.

remeasured_2026_09_17.state_is_hue_not_lightness: Neutral chrome sits at a hue of 227-240 degrees, everything active at 250-272 — at practically the same lightness. #24262e (228) and #24202d (258) are the same gray in two moods. An element does not get LIGHTER when it becomes active, it gets MORE VIOLET. Tokens: --raised-on, --line-on.
remeasured_2026_09_17.motion: Pulse 6,25 s per edge pass, rotation 233 s per revolution, frame gate 30 ms. My first version was nearly twice as fast.
remeasured_2026_09_17.surge_rules: Without a selection, only every SEVENTH edge carries a light point, offset i*0.177 against lockstep, participants brighter (#e3caff instead of #b499c9).
remeasured_2026_09_17.dim_instead_of_hide: Uninvolved edges at alpha .055, nodes at .23 — the overall shape remains standing as a ghost image.
remeasured_2026_09_17.contrast_NOT_carried_over: The study's entire meta-text band (7 selectors) sits at 12px with contrast 3,4 to 4,1 — below AA, with no large-text exception, and not a slip but a pattern. This is DELIBERATELY NOT carried over: replicating a study faithfully does not mean taking along its accessibility failures. Here --muted #858894 on --panel still applies, and the meta-texts stay at 11-13px with this palette's contrast.
remeasured_2026_09_17.token_system_is_a_facade: The study declares 10 variables and uses 134 unique hex literals — variables cover roughly 7 % of the color decisions, --raised is declared and never used. Whoever adopts only :root has nothing. This replica deliberately runs the other way: everything from tokens.
